items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: we were playing there every Sunday damn near.

ctx.x: look, Maggie, you'd better get you a taste, man, because you know, this guy's giving away bread." And the Reverend Gensel never offered nothing, so I just went along with the program that everything was cool. We was just working stuff out together. But I didn't know that he was giving money to the band all the time. Like, guys would come up to him and say, "I need a dollar or two for transportation" or whatever they needed the money for, and they'd give him some story, and you know, he'd give them...

When I found out about it, I said, "John, I hear you're giving money to the band." He says, "Yeah, I have to. They're always asking me for money, so I give them some." I said, "Well, don't be doing that on me. That's not okay. Then you don't know where the money is going." And he had gotten the gig over at the church at this time, and we were playing there every Sunday damn near.
